boundaries: A binding may be drafted before activation but cannot claim an active selection without the exact owner Decision, verified checks and required privacy and operating approvals.
An option review, lockfile entry, vendor name or synthetic fixture is not a deployed binding.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One selected integration boundary in one deployment environment and release.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Integration Binding meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: The release record that says exactly what version and configuration is running, why it was chosen, and how to roll it back.

boundary_conditions: A binding may be drafted before activation but cannot claim an active selection without the exact owner Decision, verified checks and required privacy and operating approvals.
An option review, lockfile entry, vendor name or synthetic fixture is not a deployed binding.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: An Integration Binding is the versioned, environment-specific link between one selected integration boundary and its exact component identities, package or service versions, configuration, adapter contract, data route, verification evidence and owner Decision, with an attributable activation and successor or rollback route.
